{{reconstructed}}
==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro||*ʕigʷal-}} / {{m|sem-pro||*ʕigl-}}, with Eblaite ''ù-gi-l[um]'' (equated with Sumerian ALI[M?] in a lexical list) as the East Semitic witness. The SED finds the often-cited comparison with Akkadian ''agālu'' “an equid” and Eblaite ''aglum'' “hinny” hardly tenable semantically, though the prominence of “foal, colt” in the Ethiopian Semitic reduplicated forms ({{m|sem-pro||*gVlgVl-}}) may reflect contamination with it.
